component.name: Mithrandir
component.summary: Linux system optimizer, cleaner and CachyOS scheduler manager

description.p: Mithrandir is a high-performance system maintenance suite, cleaner, and kernel utility written in Rust with GTK4 and Libadwaita. It delivers instantaneous cleanup scans, deep cache pruning, hardware power management, and granular control over startup services and system processes without background resource overhead.

Designed with a focus on safety and transparency, Mithrandir protects critical operating system paths, respects user sandboxes, and runs diagnostic telemetry off the main UI thread for completely stutter-free operation.

ul.li: High-Throughput Cleaner: Multi-threaded cleanup for package caches, thumbnails, application logs, and Flatpak runtimes
CachyOS & Kernel Schedulers: Dynamic management for BORE and sched-ext (SCX) BPF pluggable schedulers
Hardware Power Profiles: Coordinated CPU Turbo Boost, governors, EPP power profiles, and PCIe ASPM management
Pure Rust System Tray: StatusNotifierItem and DBusMenu panel integration adapting automatically to Light/Dark desktop themes
Zero-Sleep Real-Time Telemetry: Instant CPU delta calculation, dual GPU metrics, and battery health reporting
Debounced Smart Boost: Safe one-click memory optimization and temporary file reclamation
Adaptive Libadwaita Interface: Responsive layout conforming strictly to GNOME HIG on desktop and mobile screens

screenshot.caption: Mithrandir real-time hardware telemetry and one-click Smart Boost
CachyOS BORE and sched-ext BPF scheduler management with system power presets
Multi-category cache cleaner with strict Flatpak sandbox guardrails
Multi-backend software uninstaller for Native, Flatpak, Snap, and Pip packages
GRUB bootloader kernel parameters and timeout management
AI Optimizer connecting to cloud APIs, local agent sessions, and local LLM runners
Preferences dialog with GNOME 47 accent colors, hardware acceleration, and tab visibility

ul.li: AI System Optimizer: real-time GNU/Linux tuning powered by NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B with DFlash speculative decoding.
Codebase deduplication: unified host command execution via HostBridge across Flatpak and bare metal.
Purged dormant ClamAV remnants and unused settings fields.
Resolved asynchronous channel dispatch in GRUB bootloader manager.
Eliminated redundant heap allocations in telemetry loops and static mutex locks.
Targeted process collection reducing sysinfo overhead and memory consumption.

description.p: Mithrandir v1.0.0 Official Release — Unified GNU/Linux optimizer, CachyOS BORE and sched-ext manager, safe Flatpak cache cleaner, and hardware power presets.

ul.li: Strict Flatpak sandbox cache protection preventing accidental configuration or profile deletion.
Direct support for CachyOS BORE and sched-ext BPF scheduler management.
Mithrandir presets across system power profiles, CPU governors, EPP, and Turbo Boost.
Responsive adaptive GNOME HIG interface with collapsible icon-rail sidebar.
